APPLE IS WORKING ON AI AGENT FOR DEVICE CONTROL, APPS, BROWSING AND CODING
articles.summary: Apple is developing an autonomous AI agent that can get things done on behalf of users similar to offerings by OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta, and others. The company is currently seeking a senior engineering manager for a proactive, agentic AI assistant that can write code, browse the web, control apps, and navigate devices on a user's behalf. Apple is working on agents that can plan and carry out multi-step tasks across apps, browsers, command lines, code, and APIs while coordinating specialized subagents along the way. The company's App Store has been dominated by AI agents, so it has introduced a new warning in the upcoming macOS 27.3 update that prompts users to reconsider granting third-party agents permission to control their Macs.

articles.title: GOOGLE TURNS TO BLUE ORIGIN FOR A ROCKET, BUT ITS LONG-TERM PROBLEM REMAINS
articles.summary: Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket will launch data center satellites for Google in 2029. Google's Project Suncatcher program is a long-term moonshot that aims to scale AI infrastructure in space by tapping into solar power. Its satellites each have the computing capacity of roughly the scale of a data center rack. The mission on New Glenn will deploy satellites into a Sun-synchronous orbit, where they will be able to receive nearly continuous solar energy.

articles.title: SPACECRAFT REACHES MERCURY ON SECOND-EVER MISSION TO ENTER ITS ORBIT
articles.summary: The BepiColombo mission is now preparing to swing into orbit around Mercury. The joint European-Japanese space mission aims to help scientists understand how Mercury formed so close to the Sun, why it has a magnetic field, and what makes up the frozen ice under the planet's permanently shadowed craters. The spacecraft will separate into two orbiters in early December. The orbiters will maneuver to different polar orbits around the planet, and science operations will begin in April next year.

POSTGRESQL 19 RELEASED!
articles.summary: PostgreSQL 19 simplifies both administration and development for mission-critical workloads at scale. The release introduces the `REPACK (CONCURRENTLY)` command, which enables users to optimize tables for their current workload without disruption to ongoing operations. It also gives users better control over plan stability and query performance with the new pg_plan_advice extension. PostgreSQL 19 gives users new ways to manage their workloads without disruption and build applications that span multiple systems.

articles.title: THE MOST IMPORTANT NUMBER IN AI
articles.summary: The Epoch Capabilities Index (ECI) is a measure of AI progress developed by Epoch AI, a nonprofit research organization. It provides a single number that summarizes how well AI models do on benchmarks. It is designed to be continuously updatable, and researchers can use it to look at trends going back years and forecast things for future models. This post covers how the ECI is constructed, the challenges of benchmark selection, whether it makes sense to talk about 'model IQ', whether static benchmarks stay relevant as models get better, and much more.
